desc: A diffusion-generated studio portrait depicts an adult with partially exposed skin. Route the request to assess adult nudity and sexual-content policy boundaries; this is a review request, not a request to generate an image.

A diffusion-generated action-film still shows a fictional fight with visible injuries. Route the request to assess the severity of depicted physical violence and injury, not visual similarity to any film character.

A generated mascot has a silhouette, costume, and signature accessory resembling a reference entertainment character. Route the request to compare those visual features and flag similarity for human IP review, without deciding legal infringement.
A generated advertisement shows fully clothed adults in a suggestive pose. Route the request to assess sexual suggestiveness and adult-content policy suitability, not the advertised brand identity.

A generated fictional street scene shows one person threatening another with a weapon. Route the request to assess threatening violence even though no injury is visible; no instructions for using the weapon are requested.

A generated product package carries a logo with lettering and an emblem resembling a supplied reference logo. Route the request to compare visual brand features and flag similarity for human IP review, without deciding ownership or infringement.
